output.summary: A large annual native to the Himalayas, specifically between Kashmir and Uttarakhand. It has hooded pink flowers and seed pods that explode when disturbed, and it is invasive across many areas of the Northern Hemisphere.
output.edibilityNote: Nectar, green seed pods, seeds, young leaves and shoots are edible; flowers are made into jam or parfait. Eat in moderation because of oxalates.
